What's Intuit Intelligence?

Intuit Intelligence is how we build the future of financial technology. By integrating cutting-edge AI, human expertise, and powerful data, we deliver done-for-you experiences and unique insights that fuel the financial success of tens of millions of customers worldwide. A career at Intuit means innovating with the latest technology to solve complex and meaningful problems at scale. Join us in defining the future of finance and the trajectory of your career.

OUR PLATFORM

Harness the power of AI and connected data to fuel financial success for tens of millions of customers around the world

MAILCHIMP

Make marketing for small businesses easier with AI-backed tools

Mailchimp provides the momentum small businesses need to help them grow the way they want. Our MailChimp team's efforts go beyond making these tools simple and easy to use, to making them quietly powerful with AI-driven content and insights. So as our customers' businesses grow, the services we offer grow alongside them.

TURBOTAX

Give taxpayers more time, money, and confidence

Our TurboTax teams work year-round innovating new ways to make taxes simpler. Combining the power of AI with human experts, TurboTax takes the complexity out of the tax code, helping people get the maximum refund they deserve.

QUICKBOOKS

Help small businesses grow

50% of small businesses fail within their first five years. But our QuickBooks teams work to continuously evolve our product ecosystem to lower those odds. Leveraging technologies like Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing, QuickBooks helps small businesses achieve their dreams of prosperity.

CREDIT KARMA

Help people find the right financial products

Credit Karma helps customers find financial products for every step of their journey, from credit cards to home and auto loans. Our Credit Karma teams leverage technology and data to develop curated recommendations and build intuitive experiences around credit reports, identity monitoring, savings and more.

Intuit Israel - Where Passion Fuels Innovation

We're a global financial technology platform that helps consumers and small business manage their finance and run their business. We proudly serve tens of millions of customers.


Our site in Israel is the 2nd largest R&D center outside the U.S., employing 500+ engineers, developers, architects, data scientists, program and product manager and other technologists, specializing in the domains of Fintech, GenAI, cybersecurity, fraud prevention, and data exchange.

Search jobs

Catapult your career across multiple tech domains

Engineering

As Intuit's strategic R&D center, our engineering teams are the backbone of our AI-driven fintech platform that serves tens of millions of consumers and small businesses around the world, utilizing some of the most advanced tools in the tech stack.

Data

With tens of millions of customers, 60 petabytes of data and billions of transactions annually, our data teams are in a unique position in the financial technology space. Together, they ensure that customers get the fresh data they need, on demand, while protecting their privacy and implementing responsible AI practices.

AI Research

Intuit's Generative AI platform, GenOS, empowers engineers to swiftly scale GenAI product development, such as the Intuit Assist tool embedded across our ecosystem of products. This sets the stage for ongoing transformation and market disruption within our comprehensive product suite.

Cyber & Fraud Prevention

With trillions of dollars running through our systems, ensuring the safety of tens of millions of customers is quite a feat. Our cybersecurity experts and researchers develop and implement cutting edge financial fraud detection and prevention models, delivering remarkable accuracy.

FinTech

Every single day, millions of small and medium-sized businesses are using QuickBooks to pay suppliers, issue invoices, get paid, and manage their ongoing financials. Our Fintech and money teams enable business owners to do all of this at ease, making the process as seamless as possible and freeing them to focus on growing their business.

Global Engineering Days (GED)

GED is a biannual, week-long event where our 8,000+ technologists from across the globe can dedicate time to passion projects outside of day-to-day work. It brings our engineering community together to connect and get energized by the challenges we can solve through our AI-driven platform.

Our tech stack empowers engineers to build AI-powered solutions to people's most challenging financial problems and serve tens of millions of customers.

Dev tools & infrastructure

At Intuit, we empower developers with advanced AI tools and open-source technologies. Our AI-native development platform provides capabilities such as code generation, intelligent scaling, and seamless debugging.

Languages & libraries

We embrace polyglot development, empowering our engineers to choose the best programming languages and frameworks suited to their use cases. To enhance productivity, we provide AI-powered code generation tools tailored to Intuit's unique context.

Be part of an award-winning workplace

Intuit is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please talk with your recruiter or send a request to TalentAcquisition@intuit.com.


For more information, please read our EEO policy. Intuit encourages people with criminal record histories to apply for employment, and values diverse experiences, including prior contact with the criminal legal system. To that end, Intuit welcomes such applicants in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and other similar laws. Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia's Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here. Applicants for jobs in unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County can review a copy of the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Notice here.
